turns.user: why are the romanian deadlifts after the squats and not before
turns.reply:
Squats are programmed first because they are your main compound lift for the day. They require the absolute most energy, coordination, and total-body stability to perform safely and effectively. 

If we did Romanian deadlifts first, your hamstrings, glutes, and lower back would already be heavily fatigued. Trying to squat with fatigued posterior chain muscles makes it much harder to keep your torso upright and stable under the bar, which hurts your squat performance and increases the risk of your form breaking down. 

By starting with squats while you are completely fresh, you can safely push the weight on your primary lift, and then move on to the Romanian deadlifts to target your hamstrings and glutes when your legs are already warmed up. 

How does your lower back usually feel by the time you finish squats and start the RDLs?
